home.title: Study Hall
home.sub: Practice tests for every grade and subject. Pick your grade to begin — nothing is graded until you submit, and every miss shows the right answer and an easier way to get it.

tests.lede: Forms B and C use different numbers than the study guide, so they test the skill rather than your memory of the sheet. Concept Check tests the rules behind the arithmetic.
